description: Layered canyon cliffs flank a winding river that bends from the foreground toward the upper right. Flat-topped rock faces and short fracture lines form the irregular walls, with a circular sun above the right side.

Two groups of flat-topped canyon buttes rise from a shared straight baseline. The larger left formation has angular ledges and short fracture marks, while a circular sun floats above the smaller right formation.

Four parallel streams descend vertically with curved upper lips and curling lower ends. A scalloped horizontal waterline runs beneath them, forming a coherent view of water spilling into a lower pool.

A cluster of overlapping curved roof shells rises from a long rectangular podium. The tallest shell stands near the centre, with smaller leaning shells at the left and a low sweeping shell extending right.
A waterfront building has a stepped silhouette of broad curved sail-like roofs above a straight base. A row of waves runs beneath it, while a small rounded cloud floats above the right side.
A modern building has a tall central faceted block flanked by two outward-sloping wings. Vertical seams divide the central faces, and all three masses rise from a long shallow rectangular podium.
A broad mountain has sweeping sloping sides and a short flat summit above a jagged snow boundary. A detached circular sun floats at the upper left, completing the simple landscape.
A dam wall slopes outward toward the water between two tall straight end piers. A horizontal upper band and two short slanting spillway marks define its face above two wavy waterlines.
A broad dam wall has raised end shoulders and a recessed flat top between them. Two slanted marks run down the face, while a gently wavy lower edge follows the waterline beneath the wall.
